summary.text: Sue Polidura is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sue Polidura advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

Ballotpedia's campaign finance table lists earlier candidacies, including Rockingham 39 in 2022 (a general election loss), Rockingham 28 in 2024 (a general election loss) and New Hampshire State Senate District 21 in 2020 (a general election loss).
